working_on.notes: CI/CD now automatically builds Windows .exe, Linux .deb, and Android signed .apk simultaneously.

recent_changes.description: Implemented Responsive UI for Mobile & Desktop with LayoutBuilder and horizontal scrolling table.
Configured subprojects compileSdk 36 before evaluationDependsOn and fixed storeFile path in release.yml.

decisions_made.decision: Use LayoutBuilder with 768px breakpoint for Mobile/Desktop adaptive UI
decisions_made.reason: Allows desktop users to keep full 2-column view while mobile phone users get comfortable tab-based navigation.

decisions_made.decision: Wrap mobile table in SingleChildScrollView with minWidth 560px
decisions_made.reason: Prevents cramped columns and text wrapping on narrow phone portrait screens.

decisions_made.decision: Release signing via GitHub Secrets ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64
decisions_made.reason: Keeps private keystores out of git while automating release APK signing.
